title: Waste storage bins screened from view
text: C2.4.2 Waste storage bins are screened from view from communal areas, the street, public open space, and other areas accessible to the public.

replaces.note: Part C clause number inferred from the register's order; the Chapter 2 package maps the screening clause to Part C C2.4.3

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C2.4.1 (renumbered C2.4.2 in Chapter 3; evaluator unchanged). Merit wording changed from 'do not negatively impact' to 'minimise negative impacts'.
